data.name: QuadrantControl_Desc
data.value: Interactive four-quadrant chart with draggable arrows. Accepts and emits arrow data as JSON.

data.name: arrowsJson_Desc_Key
data.value: JSON array of ArrowData objects. Bound two-way: supply initial arrows as input; read the property to get current arrow state.

data.name: quadrantTopLeft_Desc_Key
data.value: Label shown in the top-left quadrant.

data.name: quadrantTopRight_Desc_Key
data.value: Label shown in the top-right quadrant.

data.name: quadrantBottomLeft_Desc_Key
data.value: Label shown in the bottom-left quadrant.

data.name: quadrantBottomRight_Desc_Key
data.value: Label shown in the bottom-right quadrant.

data.name: xAxisLabel_Desc_Key
data.value: Optional label rendered along the bottom edge of the chart.

data.name: yAxisLabel_Desc_Key
data.value: Optional label rendered along the left edge of the chart (rotated 90°).
